callees.name: extract_functions_from_file
callees.pre_condition: file_path is a path to an existing extracted function file; lang_key is a language key string present in EXT_TO_LANG values
callees.post_condition: Returns a list of (function_name, function_body_text) tuples extracted from the file by regex-based parsing for the given language. The length of the returned list is the count of functions the regex parser identifies in the file.
